messages:
maria: opened a PR to soften wording in the audit-log docs — avoiding absolute claims about retention/availability. also fixed a broken link to the export CLI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :white_check_mark:

ken: looking now. quick Q — do we want to keep the 'we retain for 90 days' example or make it generic? legal usually prefers 'typical retention' language.

samir: @ken we should avoid exact durations in public docs unless it's a guaranteed SLA. suggest: "Retention policies vary by customer and plan; consult your contract or contact support for specifics." That's clearer and safer.

maria: good call. i've replaced the 90 days line with your suggested phrasing and left a note in the PR for enterprise-specific examples. added a python SDK snippet for export that needed a path fix:

maria: ```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
resp = client.export_audit_logs(scope="tenant", start="2024-01-01", end="2024-03-31")
print(resp.url)
```

alexa: small nit — update the snippet to use the new ExportConfig param name, it's now `date_range` not start/end. otherwise looks good.

maria: updated snippet w/ date_range and added a Go example. also fixed the dead anchor on the 'export formats' header (was #exporter-formats, should be #export-formats).

ken: can you add a one-line blurb in the UX about "audit exports may include pseudonymized fields by default"? it'd help set expectations.

samir: +1 but rephrase: "Exports may mask sensitive fields depending on account settings and compliance requirements." That keeps it non-committal.

maria: done. pinging @jordan for a quick link-check and final copy review. also tagging docs-bot to run the staging build.

jordan: running link-check now. will reply with any failures in ~5m.

docs-bot: deploy-preview started for branch docs/pr-482 — staging URL: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/pr-482 — build id 202332

jordan: link-check results: one external CDN link times out (cdn.example.com). recommended to replace with archived copy or add note. everything else passes.

maria: swapped CDN link for archived copy; pushed final commit. thanks all — will merge after CI passes. :tada:
